description: Flat record-level metadata schema for CRISPR-Cas9 perturbation followed by mass spectrometry-based high-throughput screening of protein interactions and signaling changes in cancer cell lines.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record/observation.

study_id.descr: Identifier for the study, project, or screening campaign from which the record was generated.

pubmed_id.descr: PubMed identifier for the supporting publication, if available.

doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for the supporting publication, preprint, or dataset release, if available.

reference_citation.descr: Human-readable literature reference supporting this observation, including authors, year, journal, or preprint source.

organism.descr: Source organism; typically Homo sapiens for human cancer cell line experiments.

cell_line_name.descr: Name of the cultured human cancer cell line used in the experiment, for example HeLa, A549, MCF-7, or K562.

cell_line_acronym_or_synonym.descr: Alternative name, synonym, or repository alias for the cell line, if used.

cell_line_source.descr: Repository or provenance of the cell line, such as ATCC, DSMZ, JCRB, or laboratory-derived.

cancer_type.descr: Cancer lineage or subtype represented by the cell line, for example breast, lung, colon, leukemia, or glioblastoma.

perturbed_gene_symbol.descr: HGNC gene symbol of the CRISPR-Cas9-targeted regulatory protein or gene knocked out.

perturbed_gene_id.descr: Stable database identifier for the perturbed gene, such as Ensembl Gene ID, Entrez Gene ID, or HGNC ID.

perturbation_type.descr: Type of perturbation applied; expected values include knockout, knockdown, activation, inhibition, or rescue.

editing_method.descr: Genome editing method used, typically CRISPR-Cas9, but may include CRISPRi/CRISPRa if applicable.

guide_rna_sequence.descr: sgRNA sequence used for CRISPR targeting, if recorded.

guide_rna_target_exon.descr: Targeted exon or genomic region for the CRISPR guide, if applicable.

assay_name.descr: Name of the downstream assay measuring protein-protein interaction or signaling changes, such as affinity purification mass spectrometry or label-free proteomics.

assay_platform.descr: Instrument or platform used for mass spectrometry-based detection, for example Orbitrap, Q Exactive, timsTOF, or MALDI-TOF.

protein_a_name.descr: Name or symbol of the first interacting protein in the observed pair or network relation.

protein_a_id.descr: Stable identifier for protein A, such as UniProt accession or RefSeq protein ID.

protein_b_name.descr: Name or symbol of the second interacting protein in the observed pair or network relation.

protein_b_id.descr: Stable identifier for protein B, such as UniProt accession or RefSeq protein ID.

protein_a_role.descr: Role of protein A in the record, such as perturbed gene product, bait, prey, upstream regulator, downstream effector, or complex member.

protein_b_role.descr: Role of protein B in the record, such as interacting partner, downstream effector, signaling mediator, bait, or prey.

interaction_type.descr: Observed interaction class, for example physical binding, complex association, phosphorylation-linked association, or signaling modulation.

causal_relationship_type.descr: Type of causal relationship inferred or observed, such as activates, inhibits, upregulates, downregulates, increases association with, decreases association with, or no effect.

causal_direction.descr: Direction of causality; indicates whether the perturbed gene influences protein B, protein A influences protein B, or a bidirectional/undetermined relation is reported.

directness.descr: Whether the relationship is interpreted as direct or indirect.

signaling_pathway_name.descr: Name of the signaling pathway implicated by the observation, such as MAPK, PI3K-AKT, WNT, TGF-beta, p53, or NF-kB.

pathway_component_name.descr: Specific pathway component or node affected, if distinguishable from the general pathway name.

experimental_condition_name.descr: Short name for the experimental condition, such as untreated control, knockout at 48 h, serum-starved, or drug-treated.

treatment_compound_name.descr: Any chemical or biological treatment applied in addition to gene editing, such as growth factor, inhibitor, or media supplement.

treatment_compound_concentration.descr: Concentration of treatment compound, in standard laboratory units as reported, for example nM, uM, mg/mL.

treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of treatment or incubation in hours.

time_post_editing_hours.descr: Time elapsed after CRISPR editing or transduction before assay measurement, in hours.

temperature_celsius.descr: Incubation or assay temperature in degrees Celsius.

replicate_count.descr: Number of biological replicates supporting the observation.

technical_replicate_count.descr: Number of technical replicates, if separately reported.

effect_size.descr: Magnitude of the observed effect, such as log2 fold change, interaction score, or correlation coefficient, depending on the assay.

effect_size_units.descr: Units or scale used for the effect size, for example log2FC, z-score, enrichment score, or correlation coefficient.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance of the observed interaction or causal effect.

confidence_score.descr: Composite confidence or posterior probability assigned to the interaction or causal inference, if available.

validation_status.descr: Whether the observation was validated independently, for example validated, not validated, or computationally inferred only.

validation_method.descr: Method used for validation, such as western blot, co-immunoprecipitation, reciprocal IP-MS, knockdown rescue, or targeted MS.

controls_used.descr: Description of experimental controls used, such as non-targeting sgRNA, wild-type cells, or mock-treated samples.

protein_abundance_change.descr: Observed change in abundance of the measured protein, if directly quantified.

protein_abundance_change_units.descr: Units for protein abundance change, for example log2FC or percent change.

interaction_score.descr: Numerical score summarizing interaction strength from the screening workflow, if separately reported.

ms_peptide_count.descr: Number of peptides supporting the protein identification in mass spectrometry.

ms_spectral_count.descr: Number of spectra assigned to the identified protein or interaction, if reported.

instrument_model.descr: Mass spectrometer model used, for example Orbitrap Fusion Lumos or timsTOF Pro.

sample_preparation_protocol.descr: Brief description of sample preparation workflow, including enrichment, digestion, labeling, or fractionation steps.

data_processing_software.descr: Software or pipeline used for raw data processing, database search, quantification, or inference.

protein_database_used.descr: Protein sequence database used for MS identification, such as UniProt human reference proteome.

fdr_threshold.descr: False discovery rate threshold used for filtering identifications or interactions.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to interpretation, edge cases, or experimental caveats.
